From: Elena Morales <elena@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IR tabletop artifacts + telemetry snapshot

Hi Rafael,

We're in the middle of a scheduled vendor security review for Greenline Health and our audit team asked us to collect a short package of incident response artifacts from key platform providers. Can you confirm you can provide the following by end-of-day Friday (2025-10-17)?

- A copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) — redacted as necessary for internal contact details.
- Notes and outputs from the most recent IR tabletop exercise (redacted): participant list, scenarios, and key takeaways.
- A small, sanitized telemetry snapshot covering an auth spike on 2025-06-22 (sample CSV or equivalent).
- A SIG/CAIQ crosswalk or statement referencing where those artifacts map to the SIG controls in scope.

We understand some items will be sensitive; acceptable delivery mechanisms for artifacts are SFTP or a shared Drive link, with a short README describing redaction. If you need to run a quick redaction pass, we're happy to accept an initial summary and then the sanitized artifacts.

Also please call out any retention/PII concerns and whether there's an NDA or additional DPA step required before transfer. If you can't meet the Friday date, let us know an alternate date.

Thanks — this is in support of our Q4 SOC 2 readiness window.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Greenline Health

Attachment: vendor-ask-template.docx (docx)
